profile.description: Active annual Lander Cycling Club mountain-bike festival with all-ages clinics, rides, music, games and kid/adult Strider races.

notes.subject: Current contact corrected; old unread item was forwarding notice
notes.body: The Aug. 3, 2026 automated response said the Jurassic Classic had moved to jurassicclassic@landercycling.org and that Adventure Zone's email had been forwarded. Stacy Wells was identified as Festival Director. Current official sources confirm the festival remains active; 2026 ran Aug. 14-16 with all-ages clinics, rides, live music and games. The automated forwarding notice was not a decline. Verify whether there was a later human response before future outreach.

followUps.label: Review 2027 Jurassic Classic family-area fit
followUps.reason: The festival is active and all-ages, but it is cycling-centered. Check whether a separate family/kids attraction area would genuinely add value before contacting Stacy.
